title: Test-time Verification via Optimal Transport: Coverage, ROC, & Sub-optimality
authors_zh: Arpan Mukherjee、Marcello Bullo、Debabrota Basu、Deniz Gündüz（机构：帝国理工学院、Université de Lille、Inria、CNRS）
paper_type_zh: 测试时验证的理论与实证研究（ICLR 2026）
best_for_zh: 设计或审计验证器引导的候选生成与选择流程的读者。
one_line: This work models verifier-guided test-time scaling as optimal transport, exposing coverage, verifier, and sampling trade-offs.
该工作将验证器引导的推理时扩展建模为最优传输，揭示覆盖率、验证器与采样之间的取舍。
why: It explains why extra samples can help, stop helping, or hurt when verification is imperfect.
inclusion_reason: It analyzes how verifier accuracy, generator coverage, and sampling choices jointly determine inference-time scaling behavior.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Verifier-guided inference commonly follows a simple recipe: sample candidate answers, score them, and return the candidate preferred by a verifier. In practice, performance then depends on at least three coupled factors: whether the generator ever covers a good answer, where the imperfect verifier is reliable, and how efficiently the sampling policy uses its limited trials. Existing discussions often isolate one factor and consequently make extra sampling sound uniformly beneficial.

This paper asks for a unified account of those interactions. It studies when additional inference-time computation should improve a verifier-based system, when it can have little effect, and when broader generation can increase the chance of selecting an undesirable answer. The target is not a new prompt recipe but a decision framework that makes the generator, verifier, and sampling algorithm jointly visible.

验证器引导的推理通常遵循一个简单流程：采样候选答案、对其评分，再返回验证器偏好的候选。但在实际中，性能至少取决于三个耦合因素：生成器是否覆盖到好答案、不完美验证器在哪些区域可靠，以及采样策略如何利用有限试次。既有讨论常把其中一个因素单独看待，因此容易把增加采样描述成总会有益。

本文要求给出这些交互的统一解释。它研究额外的推理时计算何时应改善验证器系统、何时几乎没有作用，以及更广泛的生成何时会提高选择不良答案的概率。目标不是提出新的提示配方，而是提供一种决策框架，让生成器、验证器和采样算法能够被共同看见和分析。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The paper recasts verification-guided inference as a transport problem. A generator defines a proposal distribution over possible answers, while an ideal target distribution represents the outcomes one would want to sample. The only practical access to that target is through an approximately correct verifier. This framing turns vague notions such as “better verification” or “more coverage” into quantities whose interaction can be reasoned about.

Its central lens has three parts: generator coverage, the verifier’s region of convergence, and sampling sub-optimality. Coverage says what useful material the generator can produce; the region of convergence describes where verifier guidance moves choices toward desirable outcomes; sub-optimality captures the price of the sampling rule. Their combination predicts three qualitative regimes rather than one universal scaling curve.

论文把验证器引导的推理重新表述为一个传输问题。生成器定义了可能答案上的提议分布，而理想的目标分布代表人们希望采到的结果。实际能接触目标分布的唯一途径是近似正确的验证器。这一表述把“更好的验证”或“更多覆盖”这类模糊说法，转化为可以推理其相互作用的量。

其核心视角包含三部分：生成器覆盖率、验证器的收敛区域和采样次优性。覆盖率说明生成器能产出哪些有用材料；收敛区域描述验证器引导会在哪些位置把选择推向理想结果；次优性则刻画采样规则付出的代价。三者结合预示了三种定性区间，而不是一条普适的扩展曲线。

title: Method
方法
html:
The authors formalize a proposal distribution from the reference language model and a target distribution accessible only through an approximate verifier. They use optimal transport to characterize how coverage, verifier behavior, and the sampling procedure interact. The analysis considers both sequential and batched sampling algorithms, explicitly connecting their computational structures to the quality of the transported, verifier-selected output distribution.

The resulting analysis identifies a transport regime, a policy-improvement regime, and a saturation regime in the sub-optimality–coverage relationship. The work then corroborates the theory empirically with Qwen, Llama, and Gemma models. In this card’s terms, the operational records are candidate answers, verifier assessments, coverage under a sampling budget, and the selection rule—not an additional fine-tuning dataset or parameter update.

作者将参考语言模型给出的提议分布，以及只能通过近似验证器接触的目标分布形式化。他们使用最优传输来刻画覆盖率、验证器行为和采样程序如何交互。分析同时考虑串行与批量采样算法，并把二者的计算结构明确连接到经验证器选择后的输出分布质量。

由此得到的分析，在次优性与覆盖率关系中识别出传输区间、策略改进区间和饱和区间。工作再用 Qwen、Llama 和 Gemma 模型的实验印证理论。就本卡而言，实际记录是候选答案、验证器判断、采样预算下的覆盖率和选择规则，而不是额外的微调数据集或参数更新。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official ICLR paper supplies theoretical characterizations of the three regimes and reports empirical results with Qwen, Llama, and Gemma models. The experimental role is to test whether the predicted interaction between generator coverage, verifier behavior, and sampling sub-optimality appears in realistic language-model systems, rather than assuming a perfect verifier or reducing performance to pass-at-k alone.

The evidence is most useful as a diagnostic lens for interpreting a scaling curve. If a system plateaus after more candidates, the framework asks whether coverage has already saturated, the verifier’s effective region is too narrow, or the sampling algorithm is the bottleneck. The paper does not establish a universal numerical threshold for all tasks; readers should inspect its assumptions and empirical settings before mapping its regimes onto a particular reward model, evaluator, or serving budget.

官方 ICLR 论文给出了三种区间的理论刻画，并报告了使用 Qwen、Llama 和 Gemma 模型的实证结果。实验的作用是检验生成器覆盖率、验证器行为和采样次优性之间预测的交互，是否会出现在真实语言模型系统中，而不是假定验证器完美，或只把性能简化为 pass-at-k。

这些证据最适合作为解释扩展曲线的诊断视角。如果系统在增加候选后趋于平台，框架会追问：覆盖是否已经饱和、验证器的有效区域是否过窄，还是采样算法成为瓶颈。论文没有为所有任务建立一个普适数值阈值；读者在将这些区间映射到某个奖励模型、评估器或服务预算之前，应检查其假设和实证设定。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
This work’s novelty is to make an imperfect verifier a first-class object in a test-time scaling theory. It does not assume that the verifier merely adds noise around an otherwise fixed pass-at-k curve. Instead, the verifier’s region of convergence is modeled together with what the generator covers and how the sampler moves through that space, so poor outcomes can be attributed to a specific interaction rather than to “insufficient compute” in general.

The paper also distinguishes sequential from batched sampling in the same framework. That distinction matters operationally because the two procedures consume computation differently and may respond differently to verifier imperfections. The contribution is therefore a joint geometry for deciding whether to expand candidate coverage, improve verification, or replace the sampling procedure, rather than a single empirical recipe for more samples.

这项工作的创新，是在推理时扩展理论中把不完美验证器作为一等对象。它不假定验证器只是在原本固定的 pass-at-k 曲线周围加入噪声，而是把验证器的收敛区域与生成器覆盖内容、采样器如何在该空间中移动一起建模。因此，不良结果可以归因于某种具体交互，而不只是笼统地归因于“计算不足”。

论文也在同一框架中区分串行与批量采样。这一区分具有实际意义，因为两种程序消耗计算的方式不同，对验证器缺陷的反应也可能不同。因此，贡献是一套联合几何，用来决定应扩大候选覆盖、改善验证，还是更换采样程序，而不是一条增加更多样本的单一经验配方。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The analysis relies on modeling choices about the proposal distribution, target behavior, and verifier approximation that may be difficult to estimate for a production system. Its empirical demonstrations use the reported models and tasks, so open-ended generation, tool-mediated episodes, and nonstationary online verifiers can create effects not represented by the stated regimes. Moreover, a theoretically informative decomposition does not automatically give a cheap online estimator for coverage or the verifier’s region of convergence; practitioners still need measurements, calibration studies, and cost-aware stopping rules.
该分析依赖于对提议分布、目标行为和验证器近似的建模选择，而这些量对生产系统可能难以估计。其经验展示使用的是报告中的模型和任务，因此开放式生成、工具介导轨迹以及非平稳在线验证器，可能产生该区间划分未表示的效果。此外，理论上有信息量的分解并不会自动给出廉价的在线覆盖率或验证器收敛区域估计器；实践者仍需要测量、校准研究和成本感知的停止规则。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper to audit a verifier-guided inference pipeline before increasing its sample count. Instrument the pipeline to estimate candidate diversity and success coverage, verifier agreement with trusted outcomes, the difference between sequential and batched selection, total verifier calls, and wall-clock cost. Those measurements turn the paper’s three-way diagnosis into a practical choice: invest in a broader generator, a better-calibrated verifier, or a less sub-optimal sampling rule. It is especially valuable when a pass-at-k improvement has stopped translating into selected-answer quality.
在提高采样数之前，可用这篇论文审计验证器引导的推理流程。应为流程记录候选多样性和成功覆盖率的估计、验证器与可信结果的一致性、串行和批量选择之间的差异、验证器调用总数及实际耗时。这些测量能把论文的三方诊断转化为实际选择：投资于更广的生成器、更好校准的验证器，或更少次优的采样规则。当 pass-at-k 的提升已不再转化为被选答案的质量时，它尤其有价值。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the theorem assumptions and empirical protocol together. Note exactly how coverage, the verifier’s region of convergence, and sub-optimality are operationalized, then ask whether those quantities are observable in the target system. In a replication, keep the generator and total candidate budget fixed while varying verifier calibration and sequential versus batched sampling; report selected-answer quality separately from candidate-set pass-at-k. That separation is crucial, because a generator can cover correct answers while an imperfect verifier or sub-optimal sampler prevents the system from selecting them.
阅读时应把定理假设与实证协议放在一起看。需要准确记录覆盖率、验证器收敛区域和次优性如何被操作化，再问这些量在目标系统中是否可观察。复现时可固定生成器和总候选预算，同时改变验证器校准及串行或批量采样，并把被选答案质量与候选集合的 pass-at-k 分开报告。这一区分至关重要，因为生成器可能覆盖了正确答案，但不完美验证器或次优采样器会阻止系统选中它们。
